verdict.rationale: Cloud Functions for Firebase explicitly lets developers define serverless code that automatically runs in response to background events, HTTPS requests, Admin SDK actions, or Cloud Scheduler jobs, and this is reinforced by one-command deployment and multi-language support. This directly matches 'rules that trigger actions automatically on events.' Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of complex event-trigger chains and more detail on rule-based (vs. code-based) triggers.
